§a[Welcome] 123Technology Machine Guide§r
Welcome to the 123Technology mod!

This quest line introduces the mod's multiblock machines, grouped by the tier at which their recipes become available:
  Tier 0.5 -- Steam Age
  Tier 1   -- LV   (32 EU/t)
  Tier 2   -- MV   (128 EU/t)
  Tier 3   -- HV   (512 EU/t)
  Tier 4   -- EV   (2,048 EU/t)
  Tier 5   -- IV   (8,192 EU/t)
  Tier 6   -- LuV  (32,768 EU/t)
  Tier 7   -- ZPM  (131,072 EU/t)
  Tier 8   -- UV   (524,288 EU/t)
  Tier 9   -- UHV  (2,097,152 EU/t)
  Tier 10  -- UEV  (8,388,608 EU/t)
  Tier 11  -- UIV  (33,554,432 EU/t)
  Tier 12  -- UMV  (134,217,728 EU/t)
  Tier 13  -- UXV  (536,870,912 EU/t)

Quest requirements: simply tick the checkbox; you do not need to hold an item.
Enjoy the mod! BB~
